senses.gloss: m. (Siculus, Σίκελος) Sicilian, esp. Sicilian cook (v. Sm. Ant. Engl. ed.3 s. v. Cena, I, p. 394ᵇ) sausage-maker.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 4:5:2">Y. Bets. IV, 62ᶜ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="B00079"><he>בגומא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:28">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ההן ס׳ כד מבחר וכ׳</he> (not <he>מכחד</he>) when the sausage-maker selects from the scraped meat, from the garlic &c. (v. <cite ref="B00484"><he>בְּחַר</he></cite>).—Pl. <he>סִיקוּרַיָּיא</he>, <cite ref="O00814"><he>סִיקִי׳</he></cite>. Y. Shek., Bab. ed. VII, 2 <he>יחכמון ס׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>סִיקוּרֵי</he>, Var. in eds. <he>סילוקוס</he>, <he>סיליוקיס</he>; Y. ed. 50ᶜ bot. <cite ref="O00817"><he>סיקייריא</he></cite>) let the sausage-makers identify their product (whether the sausage found was or was not of their make), v. <cite ref="N00412"><he>נוּקָנִיקָא</he></cite>.
